Description

While moogle legends describe Moggle Mog as a kind, benevolent presence, the primal summoned by Mooglesguard is driven by the need to feast on ever-greater amounts of aether along with a large following to further solidify his being. - Moggle Mog

Defense

AC 27, touch 14, flat-footed 25 (-2 size, +6 dex, +13 natural)

HP 650 [882] (21d12+168)

Fort +21, Ref +18, Will +19

DR 10/-; Immune Holy; Resist Earth 10, Fire 10, Ice 10, Water 10, Wind 10; SR 30

Weakness Shadow

Offense

Speed 20 ft; Fly 60 ft (Good)

Melee +3 Planson +28/+24/+18/+14 (3d8+12/19-20×2)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15.

Special Attacks Memento Moogle, Pom Absorption

Statistics

STR 20, DEX 22, CON 24, INT 18, WIS 24, CHA 22

Base Atk +21; CMB +28; CMD +44

Feats Furious Focus, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Critical (Planson), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Planson), Weapon Specialization (Planson), Vital Strike

Skills Bluff +32, Diplomacy +32, Escape Artist +27, Fly +27, Knowledge (history) +25, Knowledge (local) +25, Knowledge (nobility) +25, Knowledge (planes) +25, Perception +25, Sense Motive +28

SQ Outsider Traits, Does not Breathe, Does not Eat, Does not Sleep

Good King Moggle Mog XII does not breathe.
Good King Moggle Mog XII does not eat.
Good King Moggle Mog XII does not sleep.
Good King Moggle Mog XII gains +2 Armour Class, +2 Damage Resistance and +2 to each Elemental Resistance for each moogle in play.

effect: Count the moogles in play; +2 AC, DR and elemental resistance for each.

description.value: As an immediate action, when Good King Moggle Mog's HP is reduced to 75%, 50%, 25% & 0% he will unleash a blast of energy. This ability deals 3d6 non-elemental damage per moogle currently in play to all non-moogle creatures within a 60-ft- radius. Creatures in the area of effect must make a Fortitude save (DC 26) for half damage.
